RTX’s Raytheon Applied Signal Technology seeks an Infrastructure Engineer I to help develop and support complex software and systems solutions for aerospace, defense, and signals intelligence applications. The role involves collaborative product development, systems setup and configuration, and support for field deployments.

Responsibilities
Typical job functions for the Infrastructure Engineer I include participation on collaborative, cross-disciplined integrated product teams, often employing agile software development techniques and tools to plan, design, develop, test, and integrate complex software and systems solutions. Responsibilities span the full lifecycle of product development, from architecture and design, through integration, flight test, and field support
Work on complex technical problems and provide solutions which are highly innovative while participating on collaborative, cross-disciplined integrated product teams
Once cleared, work on actual field deployments of the product under development, ensuring proper setup, configuration, and functionality of systems being deployed
Work will be performed with guidance of a product lead and team members who will assist in establishing an approach, perform code review and support in testing to achieve long-range goals and objectives
